snippet.title: Coagulation Station: Fleshfall - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649050/Coagulation_Station_Fleshfall/

Coagulation Station: Fleshfall is a small rustpunk sci-fi horror game with a small touch of humor. Operate a free-hanging elevator and explore the depths of a horrific alien world made of living tissue. 

Meet the Dev (The Big Onion Institute)
X: https://x.com/TheBigOnionDev

#fleshfall #indiegame
